summary: @servicetitan/anvil-themes preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/ (architecture-specific zip), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable (mode 493), and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~720 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle with a rotated string/constant array (WV8StW shift-based lookup) and obfuscated identifiers. This code runs automatically on npm install without user consent. The package presents itself as a design-system themes library under the @servicetitan scope with homepage v1.anvil.servicetitan.com, but the shipped preinstall dropper and large obfuscated payload have no relationship to theming and the package.json description/author fields are empty — consistent with a scope-impersonation lure. Fetching an alien language runtime at install time specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled sibling script is the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern; the obfuscation prevents inspection of what the executed code does on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
